tools.name: clinked_list_accounts
tools.description: List the Clinked accounts (organisations) the connected user belongs to, with their ids and names. Call this first to find an account id. Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts.

tools.name: clinked_get_account
tools.description: Return one Clinked account: name, settings and branding basics. Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts/{account}.

tools.name: clinked_get_subscription
tools.description: Return the subscription of a Clinked account (plan and limits as the vendor reports them). Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts/{account}/subscription.

tools.name: clinked_list_members
tools.description: List the members (users) of a Clinked account, optionally filtered by name. Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts/{account}/members.

tools.name: clinked_get_member
tools.description: Return one member of a Clinked account by username. Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts/{account}/members/{username}.

tools.name: clinked_get_profile
tools.description: Return the profile of the user the connection belongs to. Clinked API: GET /v3/profiles/me.

tools.name: clinked_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups (client portal spaces) of an account, with optional name and label filters. Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts/{account}/groups.

tools.name: clinked_get_group
tools.description: Return one group of an account (name, settings, member and job counts). Clinked API: GET /v3/accounts/{account}/groups/{group}.

tools.name: clinked_list_group_members
tools.description: List the members of one group, optionally filtered by name. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/members.

tools.name: clinked_list_announcements
tools.description: List the announcements posted in one group. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/announcements.

tools.name: clinked_list_files
tools.description: List files and folders in a group. Use parent to list one folder, name to filter, flat to search all folders. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/filesList.

tools.name: clinked_get_file
tools.description: Return the details of one file or folder in a group (name, size, owner, sharing). Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/files/{file}.

tools.name: clinked_list_file_versions
tools.description: List the earlier versions of one file in a group. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/files/{file}/versions.

tools.name: clinked_list_notes
tools.description: List the notes (pages) of a group, optionally filtered by type or name. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/notes.

tools.name: clinked_get_note
tools.description: Return one note of a group, including its content. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/notes/{note}.

tools.name: clinked_list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of a group, with filters for name, due dates, assignee, status and priority. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/tasks.

tools.name: clinked_get_task
tools.description: Return one task of a group with its assignees, due date and status. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/tasks/{task}.

tools.name: clinked_list_account_events
tools.description: List the calendar events of an account in a date range (date only, yyyy-mm-dd), optionally for one user. Clinked API: GET /v3/events.

tools.name: clinked_list_group_events
tools.description: List the events of one group, optionally filtered by name. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/events.

tools.name: clinked_list_discussions
tools.description: List the discussion threads of a group. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/discussions.

tools.name: clinked_get_discussion
tools.description: Return one discussion thread of a group. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/discussions/{discussion}.

tools.name: clinked_list_discussion_replies
tools.description: List the replies in one discussion thread of a group. Clinked API: GET /v3/groups/{group}/discussions/{discussion}/replies.

tools.name: clinked_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one file, page, event, task or discussion. Give the item type and its id. Clinked API: GET /v3/context/{context}/comments.

tools.name: clinked_search
tools.description: Search users, groups, files, notes, tasks, events and discussions. Narrow by account, group, type or date. Clinked API: GET /v3/search.

tools.name: clinked_list_notifications
tools.description: List the notifications of the connected user, with the count of new ones. Clinked API: GET /v3/notifications.

tools.name: clinked_list_audit_entries
tools.description: List audit log entries of an account for a date range (3 months at most): who viewed or changed what. Clinked API: GET /v3/cloud-audit.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "clinked_list_comments" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
